raw_segments.text: Sea Ketch sunk his head proudly between his fat shoulders and pretended to go to sleep
for a few minutes, but all the time he was keeping a sharp look out for a fight.
Now that all the seals and their wives were on the land, you could hear their clamor miles
out to sea above the loudest gales.
At the lowest counting, there were over a million seals on the beach-hold seals, mother
seals, tiny babies, and holluskicky, fighting, scuffling, bleeding, crawling and playing
together going down to the sea and coming up from it in gangs and regiments, lying over
every foot of ground as far as the eye could reach, and skirmishing about in brigades through
It is nearly always foggy at Novostoshna, except when the sun comes out and makes everything
look all pearly and rainbow-colored for a little while.
